All five faces use the same calm matte skin treatment, simple clear eyelids/irises and restrained highlights. Fabric has only principal structural folds. Food/ceramics/background are economical painted shapes rather than photographic props. Resolve faces and key gestures; let secondary detail stay quiet. Strong warm lamplight and cool-blue window shadows share one consistent direction. No plastic airbrush skin, glossy nose tips, doll blush, photographic blur, filter grain, excessive tiny highlights, random facets or evenly polished detail.

Wide landscape image, full bleed, approximately the same face positions for five save-slot crops. One continuous scene, no panel dividers, collage, extra people, text, UI, border or watermark.
